meta.name: agent-system-output-hygiene-ops
meta.description: Audit and remediate AgentSystem cron output hygiene by detecting raw tool logs, stack traces, and noisy summaries. Use when jobs leak 403/429/internal details, summaries are not user-safe, or post-change validation is required.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 审计并修复系统任务输出的日志与摘要
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果管理定时任务输出，需要清理敏感信息并确保摘要安全。
copy.tagline_en: Audit and fix cron job output logs and summaries
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you manage cron job outputs and need to sanitize sensitive info and ensure safe summaries.

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会审计并修复 AgentSystem 定时任务的输出，检测原始工具日志、堆栈跟踪和冗长摘要，确保输出简洁且适合面向用户。
howto.when: 当定时任务输出泄露 403/429 错误、内部细节或摘要不安全时触发，也用于变更后验证。

say.text: 审计当前所有定时任务的输出卫生。
修复泄露最多的任务，应用输出契约。
say.note: 修补后重新运行确认干净。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude audits and remediates AgentSystem cron output hygiene by detecting raw tool logs, stack traces, and noisy summaries, ensuring outputs are concise and safe for user-facing channels.
howto.when_en: Triggered when cron job outputs leak 403/429 errors, internal details, or summaries are not user-safe, or for post-change validation.

say_en.text: Audit all current cron job output hygiene.
Fix the top leaking jobs and apply output contract.
say_en.note: Re-run patched jobs to confirm clean.
